thread:
riley: Quick idea Mini Launch — 72h burst experiment: 200 seats, 30 credits, test two prompt onboarding nudges (tooltips vs inline walkthrough). Primary metric: day2 activation. Thoughts? :zap:

maya: Nice. Keep n=200, randomize by cookie. Tooltip = light touch, Walkthrough = step-by-step. We should track time-to-first-success too.

nate: Creative: social card + 20s demo gif. CTA: 'Try the Mini Launch'. I'll prep assets Mon AM.

leah: Ops: two office hours Wed/Thu. Email flow: confirm, 24h nudge with tip, post-burst replay + credit reminder (credits expire in 7 days).

aj: Routing: tag utm=mini_launch_72h. If user >4 requests in 24h mark as "engaged" and add to office-hours invite. I'll instrument events.

samir: Infra: pre-warm pools 15m before peak, cap GPUs at 12, fallback to quantized model at 80% util, enable prefix caching for starter templates.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscale set project/mini-launch (min=1,max=12). Alert p95 latency > 600ms -> page.

maya: Measurement spec: day1/day2 activation, time-to-first-success, CPL, webinar attendance. A/B delta report by 48h.

riley: Action items: @aj implement tags + events, @samir pre-warm + fallback, @leah emails + reg flow, @nate assets. Quick sync Tue 9:30 to confirm creative. Thanks team! :tada:
